mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the inflation signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals increased demand for housing and related goods, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face increased costs and reduced output.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply shock signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of periods with sustained RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a decreasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a deflationary environment under tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real interest rates rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the deflationary tightening signal.
